notes: Rest states for the rendering experiments of docs/qa/native-bench/RENDER.md (AuroraExp.kt). Run with --exp: BOTH sides are all-native, A with every experiment off, B with the given ones on:
python run.py --token aurora-lab-qa --states states/render.json --exp cull=1 --out <dir>   then   python strict.py <dir>
run.py's verdict uses the perceptual threshold; strict.py counts every pixel that differs at all.
Local library, profile Claude QA: row 0 = Continue Watching (frame cards, progress bars), row 1 = Recommended (posters, kind pills), row 2 = New Movies.
